408	def _is_int(value: object) -> bool:
409	    """Plain integer test; booleans are rejected (bool subclasses int)."""
410	    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)

413	def canonical_bundle_bytes(bundle: dict) -> bytes:
414	    """Sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON of the bundle with its signature removed.
415	
416	    This is the exact byte document whose SHA-256 the source signs, so signers
417	    and verifiers always agree regardless of incoming key order. The
418	    serialization mirrors :func:`ledger.crypto.canonical_message`: sorted keys,
419	    compact separators, UTF-8 bytes.
420	    """
421	    unsigned = {key: value for key, value in bundle.items() if key != "signature"}
422	    return json.dumps(
423	        unsigned, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")
424	    ).encode("utf-8")
425	
426	
427	def bundle_signing_digest(bundle: dict) -> bytes:
428	    """The 32-byte SHA-256 digest covered by a bundle Ed25519 signature."""
429	    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_bundle_bytes(bundle)).digest()

432	def verify_bundle(bundle: object, trust: object, now: float | None = None) -> dict:
433	    """Verify an offline proof bundle against the local trust document.
434	
435	    Returns ``{"ok": True, "source": ..., "S": ..., "verified_tx_ids": [...]}``
436	    on success — extended bundles also carry ``"verified_accounts"`` — or
437	    ``{"ok": False, "error": category}`` on failure. Never raises for
438	    malformed input: every defect maps to one of the five categories.
439	    """
440	    current = time.time() if now is None else now
441	    try:
442	        source, candidate = _validate_inputs(bundle, trust)
443	        _authenticate(bundle, trust, source, current)
444	        blocks_raw = candidate["blocks"] if isinstance(candidate, dict) else candidate
445	        blocks = _recompute_chain(blocks_raw, trust)
446	        descriptor = _tip_descriptor(blocks)
447	        _check_candidate_summary(candidate, descriptor)
448	        _check_response(bundle["response"], descriptor)
449	        has_state = "state_root" in bundle
450	        if has_state:
451	            _check_state_anchor(bundle, blocks)
452	        verified_ids = _verify_proofs(bundle["proofs"], blocks)
453	        verified_accounts = (
454	            _verify_state_proofs(bundle, blocks) if has_state else None
455	        )
456	    except _Failure as failure:
457	        return {"ok": False, "error": failure.category}
458	    except Exception:
459	        # Defensive: structurally unforeseeable inputs must report rather than
460	        # crash the verifying process.
461	        return {"ok": False, "error": ERR_INPUT}
462	    result = {
463	        "ok": True,
464	        "source": source,
465	        "S": descriptor,
466	        "verified_tx_ids": verified_ids,
467	    }
468	    if verified_accounts is not None:
469	        result["verified_accounts"] = verified_accounts
470	    return result

475	
476	def _validate_inputs(bundle: object, trust: object) -> tuple[str, object]:
477	    """Structural validation of bundle and trust.
478	
479	    Returns ``(source, candidate)`` where ``candidate`` is the raw candidate
480	    value (a bare block list or an export-format object carrying ``blocks``).
481	    The bundle itself is never mutated: the signature covers it verbatim.
482	    """
483	    if not isinstance(bundle, dict):
484	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
485	    for field in ("source", "expires_at", "response", "candidate", "proofs"):
486	        if field not in bundle:
487	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
488	    source = bundle["source"]
489	    if not isinstance(source, str) or not source:
490	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
491	    if not _is_int(bundle["expires_at"]):
492	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
493	    # The response is itself a JSON object; anything else cannot be checked
494	    # against the recomputed chain descriptor.
495	    if not isinstance(bundle["response"], dict):
496	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
497	    candidate = bundle["candidate"]
498	    blocks_raw = candidate.get("blocks") if isinstance(candidate, dict) else candidate
499	    if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list) or not blocks_raw:
500	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
501	    if not isinstance(bundle["proofs"], list):
502	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
503	    signature = bundle.get("signature")
504	    if signature is not None and (not isinstance(signature, str) or not signature):
505	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
506	    _validate_state_fields(bundle)
507	
508	    if not isinstance(trust, dict):
509	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
510	    if not crypto.is_hex64(trust.get("genesis_hash")):
511	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
512	    sources = trust.get("sources", {})
513	    if not isinstance(sources, dict):
514	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
515	    for name, entry in sources.items():
516	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(entry, dict):
517	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
518	        if not _is_int(entry.get("expires_at")):
519	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
520	        public_key = entry.get("public_key")
521	        # Ed25519 public keys are 32 raw bytes, i.e. 64 hex characters.
522	        if not isinstance(public_key, str) or not _HEX32_RE.fullmatch(public_key):
523	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
524	    allowlist = trust.get("allowlist", {})
525	    if not isinstance(allowlist, dict):
526	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
527	    for name, expires_at in allowlist.items():
528	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not _is_int(expires_at):
529	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
530	    return source, candidate
531	
532	
533	def _validate_state_fields(bundle: dict) -> None:
534	    """Structural validation of the optional account-state extension.
535	
536	    The four state fields are all-or-nothing; when present, ``state_root`` and
537	    ``state_block_hash`` must be 64-char lowercase hex, ``state_height`` a
538	    non-boolean non-negative integer and ``state_proofs`` a non-empty list.
539	    Every item must carry exactly ``{height, proof}`` and every proof document
540	    exactly the eight documented keys with the right JSON types. Only shape
541	    and type are judged here — domain defects (bad hex, negative balances,
542	    illegal directions) are reported later as integrity/proof failures.
543	    """
544	    present = [field for field in STATE_FIELDS if field in bundle]
545	    if not present:
546	        return
547	    if len(present) != len(STATE_FIELDS):
548	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
549	    if not crypto.is_hex64(bundle["state_root"]):
550	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
551	    if not _is_int(bundle["state_height"]) or bundle["state_height"] < 0:
552	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
553	    if not crypto.is_hex64(bundle["state_block_hash"]):
554	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
555	    state_proofs = bundle["state_proofs"]
556	    if not isinstance(state_proofs, list) or not state_proofs:
557	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
558	    for item in state_proofs:
559	        if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"height", "proof"}:
560	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
561	        if not _is_int(item["height"]):
562	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
563	        proof = item["proof"]
564	        if not isinstance(proof, dict) or set(proof) != _STATE_PROOF_KEYS:
565	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
566	        if not isinstance(proof["account"], str) or not proof["account"]:
567	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
568	        if not _is_int(proof["balance"]):
569	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
570	        transactions = proof["confirmed_transactions"]
571	        if not isinstance(transactions, list) or any(
572	            not isinstance(tx_id, str) for tx_id in transactions
573	        ):
574	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
575	        if not _is_int(proof["index"]):
576	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
577	        if not isinstance(proof["state_root"], str):
578	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
579	        if not _is_int(proof["height"]):
580	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
581	        if not isinstance(proof["block_hash"], str):
582	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
583	        if not isinstance(proof["siblings"], list):
584	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)

587	# -- stage 2/3: trust, expiry and signature -----------------------------------
588	
589	
590	def _authenticate(
591	    bundle: dict, trust: dict, source: str, now: float
592	) -> None:
593	    """Check source trust, every deadline and the optional Ed25519 signature."""
594	    sources = trust.get("sources", {})
595	    allowlist = trust.get("allowlist", {})
596	    source_entry = sources.get(source)
597	    allowlist_expiry = allowlist.get(source)
598	    if source_entry is None and allowlist_expiry is None:
599	        raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
600	
601	    # All deadlines are checked before any signature work: an expired,
602	    # correctly-signed bundle is still unusable. A source listed in both
603	    # ``sources`` and ``allowlist`` is bound by both deadlines.
604	    if bundle["expires_at"] <= now:
605	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
606	    if source_entry is not None and source_entry["expires_at"] <= now:
607	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
608	    if allowlist_expiry is not None and allowlist_expiry <= now:
609	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
610	
611	    public_key = source_entry.get("public_key") if source_entry else None
612	    signature = bundle.get("signature")
613	    if public_key is not None:
614	        # A keyed source must sign: a missing signature cannot authenticate.
615	        if signature is None:
616	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
617	        if not crypto.verify_signature(
618	            public_key, bundle_signing_digest(bundle), signature
619	        ):
620	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
621	        return
622	    # The source reached this point only through the allowlist (every sources
623	    # entry pins a key). An unsigned allowlisted bundle is therefore accepted;
624	    # a signature with no pinned key to check it against is meaningless.
625	    if signature is not None:
626	        raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
627

630	
631	
632	def _tip_descriptor(blocks: list[Block]) -> dict:
633	    tip = blocks[-1]
634	    return {
635	        "tip_hash": tip.block_hash,
636	        "height": tip.height,
637	        "length": len(blocks),
638	        "status": tip.status,
639	    }

641	
642	def _recompute_chain(candidate_raw: list, trust: dict) -> list[Block]:
643	    """Recompute and validate the whole candidate chain from the pinned genesis.
644	
645	    Mirrors the node's own candidate rules except the endowment balance replay
646	    (an offline client holds no balance convention): genesis anchor, heights,
647	    prev_hash linkage, per-transaction tx_id and Ed25519 signatures, unique
648	    tx_id-sorted transactions, Merkle roots, block hashes and the
649	    pending-only-at-tip rule. Every field is checked on the *raw* JSON value so
650	    coercions such as ``"1"`` or ``1.0`` heights are rejected outright; such
651	    type/domain defects (non-integer or negative height, non-positive or
652	    non-integer amount) are reported as ``input``, while recomputation
653	    mismatches stay ``integrity``.
654	    """
655	    blocks: list[Block] = []
656	    seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
657	    for position, block_raw in enumerate(candidate_raw):
658	        if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
659	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
660	        height = block_raw.get("height")
661	        prev_hash = block_raw.get("prev_hash")
662	        merkle_root = block_raw.get("merkle_root")
663	        block_hash = block_raw.get("block_hash")
664	        status = block_raw.get("status")
665	        txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
666	        # A height of the wrong type or sign is a field-type defect (input),
667	        # not a chain mismatch: strings, floats and booleans must never be
668	        # coerced into plausible integers before the linkage checks below.
669	        if not _is_int(height) or height < 0:
670	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
671	        if not isinstance(prev_hash, str):
672	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
673	        if not crypto.is_hex64(merkle_root) or not crypto.is_hex64(block_hash):
674	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
675	        if status not in ("pending", "confirmed") or not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
676	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
677	        if height != position:
678	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
679	        expected_prev = (
680	            GENESIS_PREV_HASH if position == 0 else blocks[position - 1].block_hash
681	        )
682	        if prev_hash != expected_prev:
683	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
684	        if position == 0:
685	            # Genesis must be the exact block the client pinned: confirmed,
686	            # empty, and carrying the trusted hash (recomputed below too).
687	            if status != STATUS_CONFIRMED or txs_raw:
688	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
689	            if block_hash != trust["genesis_hash"]:
690	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
691	        elif position < len(candidate_raw) - 1 and status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
692	            # A pending block may only sit at the chain tip.
693	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
694	
695	        tx_ids: list[str] = []
696	        for raw_tx in txs_raw:
697	            if not isinstance(raw_tx, dict):
698	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
699	            sender = raw_tx.get("from")
700	            recipient = raw_tx.get("to")
701	            amount = raw_tx.get("amount")
702	            signature = raw_tx.get("signature")
703	            stored_tx_id = raw_tx.get("tx_id")
704	            if not isinstance(sender, str) or not sender:
705	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
706	            if not isinstance(recipient, str) or not recipient:
707	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
708	            # Same rule as the block height: the raw amount must already be a
709	            # non-boolean positive integer — never a coercible string, float
710	            # or bool — so a domain/type defect is reported as input.
711	            if not _is_int(amount) or amount <= 0:
712	                raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
713	            if not isinstance(signature, str) or not signature:
714	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
715	            message = crypto.canonical_message(sender, recipient, amount)
716	            tx_id = crypto.compute_tx_id(message)
717	            if stored_tx_id != tx_id or not crypto.is_hex64(stored_tx_id):
718	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
719	            if not crypto.verify_signature(sender, message, signature):
720	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
721	            if tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
722	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
723	            seen_tx_ids.add(tx_id)
724	            tx_ids.append(tx_id)
725	        if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
726	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
727	        if crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids) != merkle_root:
728	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
729	        recomputed = compute_block_hash(height, prev_hash, merkle_root)
730	        if recomputed != block_hash:
731	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
732	        # Parsed only after every raw field has checked out; never trusted for
733	        # the comparison decisions above.
734	        try:
735	            blocks.append(Block.from_dict(block_raw))
736	        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
737	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY) from None
738	    return blocks

741	def _check_candidate_summary(candidate: object, descriptor: dict) -> None:
742	    """Cross-check an export-format candidate's own tip summary fields.
743	
744	    A bare block list has nothing to check. A five-field export document's
745	    supplied ``tip_hash/height/length/status`` must equal the recomputed tip
746	    descriptor, exactly as the node requires on resubmission.
747	    """
748	    if not isinstance(candidate, dict):
749	        return
750	    for field in DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS:
751	        if field in candidate and candidate[field] != descriptor[field]:
752	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
753	
754	
755	def _check_response(response: dict, descriptor: dict) -> None:
756	    """Every descriptor field present in the response must equal the tip's.
757	
758	    A response carrying none of the descriptor fields cannot be bound to the
759	    recomputed chain at all, so it is rejected rather than vacuously accepted.
760	    """
761	    matched = False
762	    for field in DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS:
763	        if field in response:
764	            matched = True
765	            if response[field] != descriptor[field]:
766	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
767	    if not matched:
768	        raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)

770	
771	def _check_state_anchor(bundle: dict, blocks: list[Block]) -> None:
772	    """Bind the state extension's anchor to the recomputed candidate chain.
773	
774	    ``state_height`` must name a confirmed candidate block whose hash equals
775	    ``state_block_hash``; an unknown height, a pending block or a hash
776	    mismatch is an integrity failure. Every state-proof item and document
777	    must agree with both anchor heights, the bundle's state root and the
778	    anchor block hash.
779	    """
780	    height = bundle["state_height"]
781	    state_root = bundle["state_root"]
782	    block_hash = bundle["state_block_hash"]
783	    if height >= len(blocks):
784	        raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
785	    block = blocks[height]
786	    if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED or block.block_hash != block_hash:
787	        raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
788	    for item in bundle["state_proofs"]:
789	        proof = item["proof"]
790	        if item["height"] != height or proof["height"] != height:
791	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
792	        if proof["state_root"] != state_root or proof["block_hash"] != block_hash:
793	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
794

796	# -- stage 5: proofs ----------------------------------------------------------
797	
798	
799	def _verify_proofs(proofs_raw: list, blocks: list[Block]) -> list[str]:
800	    """Validate uniqueness and cross-block consistency of every proof.
801	
802	    Each entry is ``{"height": int, "proof": doc}`` and the proof document
803	    follows the server shape ``{height, tx_id, index, merkle_root, block_hash,
804	    siblings}``. Proofs for the pending tip are forbidden. The verified
805	    transaction ids are returned sorted ascending.
806	    """
807	    verified: list[str] = []
808	    seen: set[tuple] = set()
809	    for item in proofs_raw:
810	        if not isinstance(item, dict):
811	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
812	        height = item.get("height")
813	        proof = item.get("proof")
814	        if not _is_int(height) or not isinstance(proof, dict):
815	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
816	        if height < 0 or height >= len(blocks):
817	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
818	        block = blocks[height]
819	        if block.height != height:
820	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
821	        # Pending tips never carry trustworthy proofs.
822	        if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
823	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
824	
825	        tx_id = proof.get("tx_id")
826	        index = proof.get("index")
827	        if not crypto.is_hex64(tx_id) or not _is_int(index):
828	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
829	        # The item height and the proof document's own fields must agree with
830	        # the candidate block they claim inclusion in.
831	        if proof.get("height") != height or proof.get("block_hash") != block.block_hash:
832	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
833	        if proof.get("merkle_root") != block.merkle_root:
834	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
835	        if index < 0 or index >= len(block.transactions):
836	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
837	        if block.transactions[index].tx_id != tx_id:
838	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
839	
840	        key = (height, tx_id)
841	        if key in seen:
842	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
843	        seen.add(key)
844	
845	        if not crypto.verify_merkle_proof(
846	            tx_id,
847	            proof.get("siblings"),
848	            block.merkle_root,
849	            block.block_hash,
850	            block.block_hash,
851	        ):
852	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)

857	def _verify_state_proofs(bundle: dict, blocks: list[Block]) -> list[str]:
858	    """Verify every account-state proof against the bundle's state anchor.
859	
860	    The anchor's confirmed transactions determine the ascending account set;
861	    each proof's ``account`` must belong to it and its ``index`` must be the
862	    account's position in that ordering. ``height`` + ``account`` pairs must
863	    be unique. Every proof is then checked with
864	    :func:`crypto.verify_account_proof` against the bundle's ``state_root``,
865	    ``state_height`` and ``state_block_hash``; any failure — an illegal
866	    direction or hash, a forged leaf, an illegal self-pair, a malformed
867	    sibling path — is a proof failure. Returns the verified accounts sorted
868	    ascending.
869	    """
870	    height = bundle["state_height"]
871	    # The account set of the anchor height: every account touched by a
872	    # confirmed transaction up to and including the anchor block, ascending.
873	    accounts: set[str] = set()
874	    for block in blocks[: height + 1]:
875	        if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
876	            continue
877	        for tx in block.transactions:
878	            accounts.add(tx.sender)
879	            accounts.add(tx.recipient)
880	    position = {account: index for index, account in enumerate(sorted(accounts))}
881	
882	    verified: list[str] = []
883	    seen: set[tuple] = set()
884	    for item in bundle["state_proofs"]:
885	        proof = item["proof"]
886	        account = proof["account"]
887	        expected = position.get(account)
888	        # An account outside the anchor's set, or an index that is not the
889	        # account's ascending position (including out-of-range), is a proof
890	        # failure.
891	        if expected is None or proof["index"] != expected:
892	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
893	        key = (item["height"], account)
894	        if key in seen:
895	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
896	        seen.add(key)
897	        if not crypto.verify_account_proof(
898	            proof,
899	            bundle["state_root"],
900	            height,
901	            bundle["state_block_hash"],
902	        ):
903	            raise _Failure(ERR_PROOF)
904	        verified.append(account)
905	    return sorted(verified)

987	def verify_range_exports(
988	    documents: object,
989	    expected_anchor: object,
990	    trust: object,
991	    now: int | float | None = None,
992	) -> dict:
993	    """Verify an ordered batch of exported range deliveries as one chain.
994	
995	    ``documents`` must be a non-empty list of decoded
996	    ``GET /v1/forks/sync/range/export`` documents (each with the exact key
997	    order ``source, request_id, mode, expires_at, anchor, blocks, tip,
998	    attestation``); ``expected_anchor`` is the caller-pinned
999	    ``{height, block_hash}`` the first page's anchor must strictly equal;
1000	    ``trust`` is the local trust document applied to every page.
1001	
1002	    The pages are re-verified in order: the first page is checked against
1003	    ``expected_anchor``, and every later page's anchor must strictly equal the
1004	    previous page's closed ``tip`` reduced to ``{height, block_hash}`` — which
1005	    also rejects a height jump or a fork at the seam. Transaction ids must be
1006	    unique across the whole batch, not just inside one page, and a pending
1007	    block may only appear on the last page.
1008	
1009	    Returns ``{"ok": True, "anchor", "tip", "pages", "verified_tx_ids"}`` on
1010	    success — ``anchor`` the pinned anchor of the first page, ``tip`` the last
1011	    page's closed tip, ``pages`` the number of pages and
1012	    ``verified_tx_ids`` ascending across every page — or
1013	    ``{"ok": False, "error": category}`` on failure with category one of
1014	    ``input/auth/expired/integrity``. Never raises for malformed input.
1015	    """
1016	    current = time.time() if now is None else now
1017	    try:
1018	        if not isinstance(documents, list) or not documents:
1019	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1020	        # The pinned anchor is validated once up front so a malformed caller
1021	        # anchor is an input error even before the first page is inspected.
1022	        anchor = _validate_range_anchor(expected_anchor)
1023	        _validate_range_trust(trust)
1024	        pages = len(documents)
1025	        expected = anchor
1026	        first_anchor: dict | None = None
1027	        last_tip: dict | None = None
1028	        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
1029	        verified_ids: list[str] = []
1030	        for position, document in enumerate(documents):
1031	            # _verify_range_page itself rejects a page whose anchor does not
1032	            # strictly equal ``expected`` — the first page's pinned anchor and
1033	            # every later page's previous tip — so a broken seam or a height
1034	            # jump surfaces as integrity here.
1035	            page_anchor, tip, page_tx_ids = _verify_range_page(
1036	                document, expected, trust, current
1037	            )
1038	            if first_anchor is None:
1039	                first_anchor = page_anchor
1040	            # Transaction ids must be unique across pages, not merely within
1041	            # one re-verified tail.
1042	            duplicates = seen_tx_ids.intersection(page_tx_ids)
1043	            if duplicates:
1044	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1045	            seen_tx_ids.update(page_tx_ids)
1046	            verified_ids.extend(page_tx_ids)
1047	            # A pending block may only sit on the very last page: any block
1048	            # delivered after a pending tip breaks the continuous confirmed
1049	            # chain and cannot be linked to a committed predecessor.
1050	            if tip["status"] == STATUS_PENDING and position != pages - 1:
1051	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1052	            last_tip = tip
1053	            expected = {"height": tip["height"], "block_hash": tip["tip_hash"]}
1054	    except _Failure as failure:
1055	        return {"ok": False, "error": failure.category}
1056	    except Exception:
1057	        # Defensive: structurally unforeseeable inputs must report rather than
1058	        # crash the verifying process.
1059	        return {"ok": False, "error": ERR_INPUT}
1060	    return {
1061	        "ok": True,
1062	        "anchor": first_anchor,
1063	        "tip": last_tip,
1064	        "pages": pages,
1065	        "verified_tx_ids": sorted(verified_ids),
1066	    }

1069	def _verify_range_page(
1070	    document: object, expected_anchor: object, trust: object, now: float
1071	) -> tuple[dict, dict, list[str]]:
1072	    """Verify one range page, returning ``(anchor, tip, verified_tx_ids)``.
1073	
1074	    Shared core of :func:`verify_range_export` (one page) and
1075	    :func:`verify_range_exports` (a batch chaining each page's tip into the
1076	    next page's expected anchor). Raises :class:`_Failure` with the public
1077	    error category on every defect.
1078	    """
1079	    anchor = _validate_range_export_inputs(document, expected_anchor, trust)
1080	    _authenticate_range_export(document, trust, now)
1081	    # The caller-pinned anchor must strictly equal the delivered one.
1082	    if document["anchor"] != expected_anchor:
1083	        raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1084	    tail = _recompute_range_tail(anchor, document["blocks"])
1085	    tip = _range_tip_descriptor(anchor, tail)
1086	    _check_range_tip(document["tip"], tip)
1087	    if document["mode"] == "attested":
1088	        _verify_range_attestation(document, trust)
1089	    verified_ids = sorted(tx.tx_id for block in tail for tx in block.transactions)
1090	    return anchor, tip, verified_ids

1152	def _validate_range_trust(trust: object) -> None:
1153	    """Structural validation of the trust document's ``sources``/``allowlist``.
1154	
1155	    Mirrors the bundle verifier's trust rules; a ``genesis_hash`` is not
1156	    required here because the caller pins the range anchor directly. The
1157	    optional GET /v1/trust ``source_key_history`` mapping is validated too:
1158	    each source maps to a non-empty ascending array of
1159	    ``{version, public_key, activated_event_id}`` items whose versions are
1160	    dense from 1 with strictly ascending activation ids, both numeric fields
1161	    non-boolean positive integers and the public key 64 lowercase hex.
1162	    """
1163	    if not isinstance(trust, dict):
1164	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1165	    sources = trust.get("sources", {})
1166	    if not isinstance(sources, dict):
1167	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1168	    for name, entry in sources.items():
1169	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(entry, dict):
1170	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1171	        if not _is_int(entry.get("expires_at")):
1172	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1173	        public_key = entry.get("public_key")
1174	        # Ed25519 public keys are 32 raw bytes, i.e. 64 hex characters.
1175	        if not isinstance(public_key, str) or not _HEX32_RE.fullmatch(public_key):
1176	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1177	    allowlist = trust.get("allowlist", {})
1178	    if not isinstance(allowlist, dict):
1179	        raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1180	    for name, expires_at in allowlist.items():
1181	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not _is_int(expires_at):
1182	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1183	    history = trust.get("source_key_history")
1184	    if history is not None:
1185	        if not isinstance(history, dict):
1186	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1187	        for name, entries in history.items():
1188	            if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
1189	                raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1190	            if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
1191	                raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1192	            last_activated = None
1193	            for position, entry in enumerate(entries):
1194	                if not isinstance(entry, dict) or set(entry) != set(
1195	                    _HISTORY_ENTRY_KEYS
1196	                ):
1197	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1198	                version = entry.get("version")
1199	                public_key = entry.get("public_key")
1200	                activated = entry.get("activated_event_id")
1201	                # Versions are dense from 1; both numeric fields are plain
1202	                # (non-boolean) positive integers.
1203	                if not _is_int(version) or version != position + 1:
1204	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1205	                if not isinstance(public_key, str) or not _HEX32_RE.fullmatch(public_key):
1206	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1207	                if not _is_int(activated) or activated < 1:
1208	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1209	                if last_activated is not None and activated <= last_activated:
1210	                    raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1211	                last_activated = activated

1219	def _authenticate_range_export(document: dict, trust: dict, now: float) -> None:
1220	    """Check mode-specific source authorization and every deadline.
1221	
1222	    A ``plain`` export is only acceptable from an allowlisted source and must
1223	    carry ``attestation: null``. An ``attested`` export is authorized one of
1224	    two ways:
1225	
1226	    * the trust document carries a ``source_key_history`` mapping (the new
1227	      rule): the source must appear in the mapping — the historical public key
1228	      matching and signature verification happen by attestation version in
1229	      :func:`_verify_range_attestation`; the trust ``sources`` entry and its
1230	      deadline play no role, so a delivery signed under a since-rotated or
1231	      revoked key still authenticates as long as the document itself is
1232	      unexpired;
1233	    * the mapping is absent (the legacy rule): the source must be a
1234	      ``sources`` entry whose unexpired deadline is checked.
1235	
1236	    All deadlines are checked before any integrity work: an expired,
1237	    correctly-signed export is still unusable.
1238	    """
1239	    source = document["source"]
1240	    mode = document["mode"]
1241	    sources = trust.get("sources", {})
1242	    allowlist = trust.get("allowlist", {})
1243	    if mode == "plain":
1244	        if source not in allowlist:
1245	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
1246	        # A plain export carrying an attestation is not a plain delivery.
1247	        if document["attestation"] is not None:
1248	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
1249	    elif _has_key_history(trust):
1250	        # Historical-key authorization: the source (and later the attestation
1251	        # version) must resolve in the mapping; the current registry entry is
1252	        # deliberately not consulted.
1253	        if source not in trust["source_key_history"]:
1254	            raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
1255	    elif source not in sources:
1256	        raise _Failure(ERR_AUTH)
1257	
1258	    if document["expires_at"] <= now:
1259	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
1260	    if mode == "plain":
1261	        if allowlist[source] <= now:
1262	            raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)
1263	    elif not _has_key_history(trust) and sources[source]["expires_at"] <= now:
1264	        # Legacy rule only: the pinned registry entry's own deadline applies.
1265	        raise _Failure(ERR_EXPIRED)

1268	def _recompute_range_tail(anchor: dict, blocks_raw: list) -> list[Block]:
1269	    """Recompute and validate the delivered tail standalone from the anchor.
1270	
1271	    Mirrors the node's own range-tail rules: heights run consecutively from
1272	    ``anchor.height + 1``, the first ``prev_hash`` is the anchor hash and
1273	    later ones link internally, every transaction's tx_id and Ed25519
1274	    signature verifies, tx_ids are unique across the tail and ascending
1275	    inside each block, Merkle roots and block hashes recompute, and a pending
1276	    block may only sit at the tail tip. Every field is checked on the *raw*
1277	    JSON value; type/domain defects (non-integer or negative height,
1278	    non-positive or non-integer amount) are reported as ``input``, while
1279	    recomputation mismatches stay ``integrity``.
1280	    """
1281	    blocks: list[Block] = []
1282	    seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
1283	    for position, block_raw in enumerate(blocks_raw):
1284	        if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
1285	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1286	        height = block_raw.get("height")
1287	        prev_hash = block_raw.get("prev_hash")
1288	        merkle_root = block_raw.get("merkle_root")
1289	        block_hash = block_raw.get("block_hash")
1290	        status = block_raw.get("status")
1291	        txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
1292	        # Same rule as the whole-chain recomputation: a height of the wrong
1293	        # type or sign is a field-type defect (input), never coerced.
1294	        if not _is_int(height) or height < 0:
1295	            raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1296	        if not isinstance(prev_hash, str):
1297	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1298	        if not crypto.is_hex64(merkle_root) or not crypto.is_hex64(block_hash):
1299	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1300	        if status not in ("pending", "confirmed") or not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
1301	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1302	        if height != anchor["height"] + 1 + position:
1303	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1304	        expected_prev = (
1305	            anchor["block_hash"] if position == 0 else blocks[position - 1].block_hash
1306	        )
1307	        if prev_hash != expected_prev:
1308	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1309	        if position < len(blocks_raw) - 1 and status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
1310	            # A pending block may only sit at the tail tip.
1311	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1312	
1313	        tx_ids: list[str] = []
1314	        for raw_tx in txs_raw:
1315	            if not isinstance(raw_tx, dict):
1316	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1317	            sender = raw_tx.get("from")
1318	            recipient = raw_tx.get("to")
1319	            amount = raw_tx.get("amount")
1320	            signature = raw_tx.get("signature")
1321	            stored_tx_id = raw_tx.get("tx_id")
1322	            if not isinstance(sender, str) or not sender:
1323	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1324	            if not isinstance(recipient, str) or not recipient:
1325	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1326	            # The raw amount must already be a non-boolean positive integer —
1327	            # never a coercible string, float or bool.
1328	            if not _is_int(amount) or amount <= 0:
1329	                raise _Failure(ERR_INPUT)
1330	            if not isinstance(signature, str) or not signature:
1331	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1332	            message = crypto.canonical_message(sender, recipient, amount)
1333	            tx_id = crypto.compute_tx_id(message)
1334	            if stored_tx_id != tx_id or not crypto.is_hex64(stored_tx_id):
1335	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1336	            if not crypto.verify_signature(sender, message, signature):
1337	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1338	            if tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
1339	                raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1340	            seen_tx_ids.add(tx_id)
1341	            tx_ids.append(tx_id)
1342	        if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
1343	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1344	        if crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids) != merkle_root:
1345	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1346	        recomputed = compute_block_hash(height, prev_hash, merkle_root)
1347	        if recomputed != block_hash:
1348	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY)
1349	        # Parsed only after every raw field has checked out; never trusted for
1350	        # the comparison decisions above.
1351	        try:
1352	            blocks.append(Block.from_dict(block_raw))
1353	        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
1354	            raise _Failure(ERR_INTEGRITY) from None
1355	    return blocks
